# OpenAL Soft default HRTF data

The default HRTF embedded in OpenAL Soft 1.25.2 is based on the KEMAR
measurements by Bill Gardner and Keith Martin, MIT Media Laboratory (1994).
Copyright 1994 MIT Media Laboratory.

The dataset's published terms allow research and commercial use with author
attribution. These data terms are separate from the OpenAL Soft code license.

Dataset and terms: https://sound.media.mit.edu/resources/KEMAR.html
Upstream explanation: https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/blob/1.25.2/docs/hrtf.txt

This attribution covers the default embedded dataset. It does not describe
additional HRTF files installed by the end user.
